title: spec(ui): `RecordRelatedListProps.parentDataSource` still says `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and the liveness note says nothing reads it — objectui renders it since objectui PR #12407
body:
Restart-when: `npm view @object-ui/plugin-detail@next version` names a release built from objectui `d81e46043` (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12407) or later, i.e. objectui ships the `parentDataSource` renderer.

Filing gate: cross-repo rule 3. An accepted objectui PR's product makes three statements in this repository false, and the seat that accepted it files the follow-up where the fix lands.

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Reader who acts:** triage, to route to the `domain:spec` seat. The spec seat filed and landed the key (#23134, PR #23205).
- **Executable criterion:** `git grep -n "PLANNED — not yet rendered" -- packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` names no line on `RecordRelatedListProps.parentDataSource`, and `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`'s `_note` no longer carries the `PLANNED RECORD (#23134 …)` sentence as planned.

## What landed

objectstack-ai/objectui#12294 (ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12296, ruling comment 6137226306) landed as objectui PR #12407, merged as `d81e46043` on objectui `main` (landing note: objectui#12294 comment 6182685360):
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: `record:related_list` reads its parent record from `properties.parentDataSource`. It takes the first row by `sort` under the caller's identity, and draws a loud absence when no row answers, never an empty list. When the key is absent, the record page's record is the parent, as before.
- `@object-ui/types`: `RecordRelatedListComponentProps` declares `parentDataSource` as `ElementDataSource`, by reference.
- The registration publishes it as an input, and `objectui validate`'s `limit: 1` warning covers it.

It ships in the next objectui `18.0.0-next.N`. The version PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11600 is not merged yet, so its release is the maintainer's act.

## What is now false here, read at objectstack `origin/main`

1. `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1889`: the `parentDataSource` describe opens `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`.
2. `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1885`: the docblock above it ties the marker's removal to the renderer landing.
3. `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, `_note`: the `PLANNED RECORD (#23134, 2026-10-13 …)` sentence says "PLANNED, not live … nothing reads the key", with carrier "the related-list leg of objectstack-ai/objectui#12294". That carrier has landed. The sentence itself says: "When that leg lands, the marker leaves and this sentence is rewritten."

## Timing (for triage)

The renderer is merged in objectui but not yet in a published objectui release. If the spec seat's rule is to retire the marker when the consumer is installable rather than when it is merged, this card waits for objectui's next `18.0.0-next.N` on npm. Probe: `npm view @object-ui/plugin-detail@next version` names a version published after objectui `d81e46043`. Otherwise it is ready now.

Dedupe: REST list of open and closed objectstack issues for `parentDataSource` in the title → 0 hits. The spec card #23134 is closed.
